'IC + PD' is coded as '257'.

I = 9 and C= 3. So, IC is written as 93. P = 16 and D = 4. So, PD is written as 164.

93+164= 257.

Similarly,

L = 12 and G = 7. So, LG is written as 127. M = 13 and F = 6. So, MF is written as 136.

127+136= 263.

questions.q_en: In a certain code language, 'TYR' is coded as '65', and 'GAP' is coded as '26'. How will 'MOJ' be coded in that language?
questions.solution_en:
The code is by adding the position of all the alphabets according to the alphabetical series and '2' to the total sum.

TYR = (20+25+18) + 2 = 63+2 = 65

GAP = (7+1+16) + 2 = 24+2 = 26

Similarly,

MOJ = (13+15+10) + 2 = 38+2 = 40

So, 'MOJ' will be coded as '40'.

questions.q_en: If HJ= 9; PAID= 15; then what is the code for DESTINY?
questions.solution_en:
The code of a word is half the sum of the positions/ranks of letters of the word in alphabetical series.

H(8) + J(10) = 18/ 2= 9

P(16)+A(1) + I(9) + D(4) = 30/2= 15

So DESTINY=

D(4)+E(5)+S(19)+T(20)+I(9)+Y(25)= 96/2= 48
